items.title: OpenAI Gave AI Agents Their Own Computers at DevDay 2026. Here's Everything It Announced
items.whyYouShouldCare: OpenAI's advancements in AI agents could enhance Solana's ecosystem by attracting developers seeking to integrate AI capabilities into decentralized applications.

items.title: Solana’s 250ms data shows lower-stake validators lost a larger share of reward-linked vote credits
items.whyYouShouldCare: The decline in reward-linked vote credits for lower-stake validators may impact their participation and influence, affecting overall network decentralization on Solana.
